title: Starr County (TX) webjail — inmates record
description: One booking/stay as served by GET /inmates (FeathersJS envelope: {total,limit,skip,data:[...]}). Observed field set verified live 2026-09-11 by tools/api_probe.py (check H3). Unknown/extra fields should be tolerated by consumers — the county adds fields without notice.

_id.description: Mongo ObjectId. NOT accepted by the id route (see ptsSubjectID).

ptsSubjectID.description: Subject id inside the jail management system. This is the key the id route uses: GET /inmates/<ptsSubjectID> returns this single record.

ptsPersonID.description: Person id. Distinct per human; two same-name bookings with different ptsPersonID are different people.

ptsBookingID.description: Unique per booking/stay. The join key to /offences and /inmate-detail, and the dedupe key for watchers.

BookingID.description: Public booking number: YYYY + zero-padded 6-digit sequence. Lexicographic sort == chronological.

BookingDate.description: Calendar date the county logged the booking, serialized at UTC midnight (time part is meaningless, do not treat as an instant).

DOB.description: UTC midnight, date-only. Sentinel values like 0000-00-00 have been observed historically — validate before formatting.

Gender.description: Observed values; the /inmates/get/genders-races endpoint lists the same two.

Race.description: Uppercase word. Observed WHITE (majority), BLACK; the genders-races endpoint only lists BLACK/WHITE.

EyeColor.description: BROWN, GREEN, BLACK, BLUE, HAZEL observed.

HairColor.description: BLACK, BROWN, GREY OR PARTIALLY GREY, BALD observed; null possible.

MugShotFileStream.description: Raw base64 image with NO data: prefix (verified: 100% of records start iVBORw0KGgo = PNG). Median ~267 KB base64 (~200 KB decoded). Strip a data: prefix defensively. Respect PublishImageToWebjail.

PublishImageToWebjail.description: false = the county withholds this photo from the public site (~12% of the roster at last probe). Mirroring consumers must not publish it.

createdAt.description: API insert time, ISO with ms. Hourly batch: seconds cluster at :00:01-:00:02 UTC. Median ~21 h after BookingDate (min 6 h, max 89 h observed). Use this for new-record watermarks.

updatedAt.description: Re-stamped on EVERY record at the top of every hour (the sweep takes ~50 s). Useless for change detection.
